<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>NSE IPO Milestone:</strong> SEBI has agreed to settle all pending cases against the National Stock Exchange for Rs 1,491.21 crore, removing a significant regulatory hurdle for its upcoming IPO.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional Shift:</strong> Domestic Institutional Investor (DII) holdings in the Nifty 500 have reached a record 21%, even as Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) stakes hit an all-time low.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
